why: as 035, through a path: inside p's look-back a is the earlier 1, which has no z, so p = "x"; a keeps the memoized 1 (expect) or is an alias for the final p (also_valid). typesafe/config gives a = "x", which is the second reading, though for 035 it takes the first. The order the fields resolve in is undefined, so an error is allowed too (L866-881).
